findings.reason: without an over-refusal control the node can ship a gate that refuses the derived parents and the successors-held orphans §35 exists to separate, and the measure cannot show it.
findings.text: §37's done-when tests only "one planted sourceless live name" (refuse) and "a clean fixture passes", so the two exclusions the check depends on — a derived parent, which §35 says "legitimately" has no source, and an exhausted orphan whose live successor holds its sources — are never driven; a gate that refuses every sourceless name, including those two populations, would pass the whole done-when while blocking legitimate names at every release

findings.reason: the missing edge lets §38 be dispatched before the audit it reads back through exists, so its done-when cannot be met as written.
findings.text: §38's section element declares `data-links="sn-integrity-backlog#s35,sn-integrity-backlog#s36"`, but §38's own text ("This section runs after §37, whose audit is its read-back instrument") and its done-when ("a read-back after repair in which §37's audit reports no live, non-derived, non-orphan name without a DD source") both require §37 to exist first

findings.reason: the same defect the earlier review raised against §27 was acted on by naming a path, and the same one-line fix removes the ambiguity here.
findings.text: §35's done-when names the census fragment (`sib-source-loss-census.html`) but requires "The results JSON beside it lists every name" without naming the file, so a later reader has no declared location to open and each node chooses its own filename

findings.reason: naming the existing predicate as the one to extend (or stating why it is insufficient) is what stops the node from writing a parallel check whose terms ("derived parent" vs "live structural child") drift from the export's own.
findings.text: §37 proposes a `run_audits` check ("not a derived parent, has no DD source") and an export gate that runs it, but export.py already applies `_has_producing_source` (export.py:877) as `reason = "no_producing_source"` with the different gloss "no PRODUCED_NAME edge reaches the name and no live structural child carries the evidence for it"; the plan does not reconcile the two, so it would place a second, semantically divergent definition of a sourced name on the same export path
